markers.impact: APOE e4 isoform structural driver / LDL cholesterol elevations
markers.interpretation: APOE rs429358 C is one of the two alleles used to assign an APOE e2/e3/e4 haplotype; rs7412 must be interpreted with it. An e4 haplotype is associated with higher LDL cholesterol and higher cardiovascular and late-onset Alzheimer’s disease risk in population studies, with effects varying by copy number, ancestry, age, and other factors.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Haplotype determination from single raw SNPs can occasionally fail if phasing is incorrect. Clinically confirm haplotype structure.

sources.name: APOE Haplotypes and Alzheimer's Risk Consensus
sources.notes: Documents the highly robust risk increase in APOE e4/e4 homozygotes.

markers.impact: APOE isoform determination (e2, e3, e4 haplotype)
markers.interpretation: rs7412 is the second allele used with rs429358 to assign the APOE e2/e3/e4 haplotype. T/T at rs7412 with T/T at rs429358 is consistent with e2/e2, which is often associated with lower LDL but can increase Type III hyperlipoproteinemia susceptibility; G/G at rs7412 with C/C at rs429358 is consistent with e4/e4. Confirm the haplotype clinically before acting on it.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Haplotype phasing requires validating both APOE loci (rs429358 and rs7412) in tandem.

sources.notes: ClinVar catalog mapping the alleles to ApoE polypeptide variants.

markers.impact: Altered cell cycle regulation in vascular walls
markers.interpretation: The 9p21 non-coding region regulates vascular smooth muscle. The rs10757278 G allele is one of the most replicated risk markers for early-onset coronary artery disease and myocardial infarction, independent of lipid levels.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Polygenic hazard score; absolute risk is highly modifiable by dietary lipids, smoking, and blood pressure control.

sources.name: 9p21 locus association with coronary artery disease

markers.impact: Altered nitric oxide synthesis / vascular recovery
markers.interpretation: NOS3 synthesizes nitric oxide, which regulates vasodilation and blood flow. The T (Asp) allele reduces enzyme function, potentially impairing endothelial nitric oxide production, athletic recovery, and arterial dilation under stress.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Nitric oxide levels are highly modifiable by dietary inorganic nitrates (beets, leafy greens) and UV sunlight exposure.

sources.name: NOS3 Glu298Asp and vascular function
sources.notes: Shows reduction in endothelial nitric oxide synthase enzyme stability in T-carriers.

markers.impact: Reduced nitric oxide synthase promoter transcription
markers.interpretation: The C allele of rs2070744 is located in the NOS3 promoter, decreasing transcription rate. Associated with reduced basal nitric oxide production. Works synergistically with rs1799983 to affect vascular tone.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Exercise training induces NOS3 transcription and can overcome genetic promoter reductions.

sources.name: NOS3 promoter polymorphism and coronary spasm
sources.notes: Demonstrates reduction in reporter gene transcription driven by the -786C variant.

markers.variant_name: LPA kringle IV repeat-linked risk marker
markers.impact: Elevated lipoprotein(a) / coronary artery disease and aortic valve risk
markers.interpretation: The LPA rs10455872 G allele is strongly associated with higher lipoprotein(a), smaller apo(a) isoforms, and higher coronary artery disease risk. This is one of the cleanest consumer-array Lp(a) markers, but measured Lp(a) is still the actionable phenotype.
confirm_with: Lp(a) blood test in nmol/L or mg/dL
aortic valve calcium/echo if clinically indicated
markers.raw_dna_limitation: A negative result does not rule out genetically high Lp(a), because LPA kringle IV copy number and other variants may not be captured in raw SNP files.

markers.impact: Elevated lipoprotein(a), thrombosis tendency, coronary artery disease risk
markers.interpretation: The LPA rs3798220 C allele is associated with increased Lp(a), higher coronary disease risk, and possible thrombotic signal. It should trigger measurement, not treatment automation.
confirm_with: bleeding risk review before any aspirin discussion
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Consumer raw DNA can tag this SNP but cannot quantify Lp(a). Lp(a) concentration and global bleeding risk matter more than genotype alone.

markers.impact: Reduced PCSK9 activity / lower LDL cholesterol / lower CAD risk
markers.interpretation: The PCSK9 rs11591147 T allele encodes the R46L loss-of-function variant. Carriers tend to have lower LDL-C and lower coronary disease risk, modeling the biology targeted by PCSK9 inhibitors.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Protective common/low-frequency alleles reduce average risk but do not override ApoB exposure, smoking, hypertension, diabetes, inflammation, or family history.

markers.interpretation: The rs599839 G allele at the CELSR2-PSRC1-SORT1 locus has been associated with lower LDL-C and lower atherosclerotic burden in several cohorts. The locus is mechanistically linked to hepatic sortilin regulation of lipoprotein secretion.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: The 1p13.3 locus is ancestry- and LD-sensitive. Raw SNP files may report a tag SNP without resolving the causal regulatory variant.

markers.interpretation: The HMGCR rs12916 T allele tags reduced HMGCR activity and lower LDL-C in many datasets. It is useful as a biology-of-statin-target marker, but its effect is small and not a statin-response substitute.

markers.raw_dna_limitation: This marker is a small-effect regulatory proxy. It should not be used to decide statin therapy or dosing.

markers.interpretation: The APOA5 rs662799 C allele is a replicated triglyceride-raising allele and is especially relevant when fasting TG is high, carbohydrate intake is high, alcohol intake is high, or insulin resistance is present.

markers.impact: Higher lipoprotein lipase efficiency / lower triglycerides and higher HDL tendency
markers.interpretation: The LPL rs328 G allele encodes S447X and is generally associated with more favorable triglyceride-rich lipoprotein handling, lower TG, and modestly lower coronary risk.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Effect sizes are modest and can be overwhelmed by insulin resistance, alcohol, hypothyroidism, high refined carbohydrate intake, or medications.

markers.impact: Higher hepatic glycolytic flux / higher triglycerides with lower fasting glucose tendency
markers.interpretation: The GCKR rs1260326 T allele encodes P446L and is associated with higher triglycerides but lower fasting glucose. It is a useful example of cardiometabolic tradeoff genetics.

markers.raw_dna_limitation: HDL genetics can raise HDL-C without guaranteeing lower ASCVD risk. Treat ApoB/LDL burden as the more actionable axis.

markers.interpretation: The ANGPTL4 E40K rs116843064 T allele is a low-frequency protective lipid marker associated with lower triglycerides and lower coronary disease risk in several datasets.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Low-frequency variant; array coverage and imputation quality vary. Effects are lipid-trait averages, not individual guarantees.

markers.interpretation: PITX2/4q25 rs2200733 T is one of the most replicated atrial fibrillation risk alleles. It should be used as an AF susceptibility flag, not a rhythm diagnosis.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: AF requires rhythm evidence. A risk allele only changes prior probability.

markers.interpretation: ZFHX3 rs2106261 T is a replicated AF-associated marker. It has no standalone diagnostic meaning but is useful in AF PRS/pathway interpretation.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Small-effect common variant; environmental and structural triggers matter.

markers.interpretation: KCNN3 rs13376333 T is associated with AF risk in multiple studies and points toward potassium-channel/atrial repolarization biology.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Small-effect susceptibility marker. Clinical rhythm monitoring is required for diagnosis.

markers.impact: Cardiac conduction interval variation / PR and QRS trait signal
markers.interpretation: SCN10A rs6795970 is associated with cardiac conduction traits such as PR interval and QRS duration. It can flag conduction biology, but not arrhythmia diagnosis.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Conduction intervals are measured directly on ECG. Genotype should only annotate biology.

markers.impact: QT interval prolongation susceptibility / repolarization biology
markers.interpretation: NOS1AP rs10494366 T is associated with longer QT interval in population studies. It is useful for drug-QT caution context, not for diagnosing congenital long QT syndrome.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: QTc is a measured phenotype and can be changed by drugs, electrolytes, illness, heart rate, and measurement method.

markers.impact: Polygenic cardiac conduction and repolarization timing
markers.interpretation: ECG intervals are heritable and polygenic. Use this module to annotate PR, QRS, and QT trait tendencies, especially when reviewing arrhythmia susceptibility and medication-QT context.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Measured ECG intervals dominate. Genetic interval scores are annotation, not clinical diagnosis.

markers.variant_name: Long QT syndrome clinical gene panel
markers.impact: Congenital repolarization disorder / syncope and malignant arrhythmia susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Pathogenic variants in KCNQ1, KCNH2, and SCN5A account for most molecularly explained congenital long QT syndrome, with additional high-impact rare genes. This belongs in a clinical sequencing track, not raw SNP scoring.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Consumer DNA may miss pathogenic variants and cannot classify VUS. Requires phenotype and clinical-grade variant interpretation.

sources.notes: States KCNH2, KCNQ1, and SCN5A account for most identified molecular causes.

markers.impact: Sodium-channel loss-of-function / Brugada syndrome susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Current expert curation recognizes SCN5A as the primary established Brugada-syndrome gene. Other proposed Brugada genes require separate current curation and phenotype correlation.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Brugada diagnosis is ECG/clinical. Many SCN5A variants are VUS; raw DNA cannot safely classify them.

sources.notes: Only SCN5A was classified as definitive; many other genes disputed.

markers.impact: Exercise/emotion-triggered ventricular arrhythmia susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Pathogenic variants in RYR2 and CASQ2 and related calcium-handling genes can cause CPVT, a high-stakes inherited arrhythmia disorder. Raw DNA cannot rule it out.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Requires electrophysiology-grade phenotype and clinical variant classification. Many rare variants are not interpretable without expert review.

sources.notes: Clinical overview of CPVT genes and diagnosis.

markers.impact: Sarcomere dysfunction / hypertrophic cardiomyopathy susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Core sarcomere genes, especially MYH7 and MYBPC3, account for a substantial fraction of genotype-positive HCM in clinical cohorts. This is a clinical panel item, not a consumer SNP trait.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Penetrance and expression vary. Raw DNA usually misses rare pathogenic variants and cannot classify VUS.

markers.impact: Dilated cardiomyopathy / heart failure and arrhythmia susceptibility
markers.interpretation: DCM genetics includes TTN truncating variants, LMNA, MYH7, FLNC, RBM20, PLN, DSP and others. Some genes imply arrhythmic risk beyond ejection fraction. This requires clinical sequencing and cardiology interpretation.
do_not_claim: ICD need prediction from raw DNA
markers.raw_dna_limitation: DCM genetics is rare-variant dominated; consumer raw DNA is inadequate. Some variants have incomplete penetrance and environment interactions such as alcohol, myocarditis, chemo, or hypertension.

sources.notes: 2024 DCM GWAS and gene prioritization study.

markers.impact: Ventricular arrhythmia and fibro-fatty myocardial remodeling susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy is often rare-variant driven, especially desmosomal genes such as PKP2, DSP, DSG2, DSC2, and JUP. Exercise exposure can modify penetrance in some genotypes.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Phenotype, imaging, rhythm monitoring, and expert variant classification are required. Consumer SNPs are not enough.

markers.variant_name: TTR Val142Ile / V122I amyloid cardiomyopathy marker
markers.impact: Destabilized transthyretin tetramer / late-onset ATTR cardiomyopathy susceptibility
markers.interpretation: TTR rs76992529 A encodes p.Val142Ile, a pathogenic variant associated with late-onset hereditary transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy, especially but not exclusively in people with African ancestry. Penetrance is age-dependent and incomplete.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: This is one of the few single variants where clinical confirmation matters. Presence is not diagnosis; absence does not rule out wild-type ATTR or other TTR variants.

markers.impact: Aortic wall weakness / thoracic aneurysm and dissection susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Heritable thoracic aortic aneurysm/dissection is rare-variant dominated. Validated genes include FBN1, TGFBR1/2, SMAD3, TGFB2, ACTA2, MYH11, MYLK, LOX, PRKG1, and COL3A1. This requires clinical genetics and imaging.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Consumer arrays cannot rule out HTAAD. Imaging phenotype and family history drive actionability.

markers.impact: Arterial/organ fragility / vascular rupture susceptibility
markers.interpretation: Pathogenic COL3A1 variants can cause vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, a high-stakes vascular fragility condition. This is not a recreational raw-DNA trait.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Variant interpretation is complex and consequences are high. Raw DNA false negatives and VUS misinterpretation are dangerous.

markers.impact: Polygenic aneurysm susceptibility / vascular wall remodeling tendency
markers.interpretation: Abdominal and thoracic aneurysm risk has common-variant components, but imaging and family history dominate. This module should be separate from monogenic HTAAD genes.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: PRS for aneurysm is not mature enough for standalone clinical action. Do not combine casually with monogenic aortopathy flags.

markers.impact: Lp(a)/LDL pathway contribution to aortic valve calcification and stenosis
markers.interpretation: Calcific aortic valve disease has a strong lipid-genetic component, especially LPA/Lp(a). Use LPA variants plus measured Lp(a) and valve imaging when clinically relevant.

markers.raw_dna_limitation: Valve disease is diagnosed by imaging. Genotype flags pathway risk but cannot measure stenosis severity.

markers.interpretation: Bicuspid aortic valve and related aortopathy can have familial genetic contributors, including NOTCH1 and SMAD6, but penetrance is variable and echo is the relevant phenotype.
confirm_with: clinical congenital heart/aortopathy panel if indicated
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Valve morphology is structural and must be imaged. Gene panels are incomplete and many cases are multifactorial.

markers.interpretation: Stroke genetics is subtype-specific. AF loci influence cardioembolic risk, 9p21/HDAC9 large-artery risk, and COL4A1/2 rare variants small-vessel disease. Do not produce one generic stroke score without subtype caveats.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Stroke is heterogeneous. A generic PRS can mislead unless separated by subtype and clinical risk factors.

markers.raw_dna_limitation: Stroke subtypes differ. A large-artery genetic signal does not mean cardioembolic or hemorrhagic stroke risk.

markers.interpretation: Heart failure is not one genetic disease. Separate rare cardiomyopathy genes from common CAD/BP/metabolic PRS and from measured cardiac function.

markers.raw_dna_limitation: Warfarin has a narrow therapeutic index. Genotype can inform initial dosing only within a clinical dosing protocol.

markers.interpretation: CRP rs1205 can influence measured CRP level, but CRP-lowering genetics does not automatically imply lower cardiovascular risk. Use to interpret baseline CRP tendency, not disease risk.

markers.impact: Acetaldehyde accumulation / alcohol flushing, BP and CAD interaction context
markers.interpretation: ALDH2 rs671 A reduces aldehyde dehydrogenase activity and is common in East Asian ancestry. It modifies alcohol response and can interact with blood pressure, endothelial stress, and cardiovascular risk under alcohol exposure.

markers.impact: Prevents overclaiming from consumer genotype files
markers.interpretation: Raw DNA should not diagnose coronary artery disease, heart failure, cardiomyopathy, aneurysm, stroke, arrhythmia, hypertension, clotting disorder, or lipid disorder without clinical phenotype. Use DNA to prioritize biomarkers, imaging conversations, family-history review, and pharmacogenomic caution.

echocardiogram/CAC/vascular imaging only if clinically indicated
